title: Billing and Coding: Debridement of Mycotic Nails

codes.1: Note : Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. Medicare is establishing the following limited coverage for CPT/HCPCS codes 11720 and 11721. Note : ICD-10-CM code B35.1 must appear on each claim in addition to one of the other ICD-10-CM codes below that indicates secondary infection, pain, or difficulty in ambulation.

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10 Codes that Support Medical Necessity” section of this article.
